scope: Native extension admission and resource-safe RENDER and SHAPE requests
invariant: Immutable connection roles authorize extension discovery and dispatch; admitted requests cannot bypass resource or pixel authority.
required_evidence: Missing-feature failures against the preceding native server
Direct forbidden opcodes rejected despite hidden discovery
Actual owned RENDER pixels, SHAPE operations, and cursor creation
Foreign pictures, glyph aliases, and cursor resources rejected
Window-picture source and alpha-map denial prevents shared-framebuffer exposure
Animated cursor timer cleanup after retained use and final cursor destruction
Focused native server sanitizers with the GLX limitation recorded
limitations: This component does not complete M04 or enable untrusted native sessions.
Application window pictures are drawing destinations only; trusted services retain window-picture access.
Unqualified extension families remain denied until their resource and device boundaries pass independent checks.
Full qualification still requires both authorized hosts and both automated build modes.
